answer: A ripple forfeit chain stops sybil farms from faking finished work. Every finished job carries a chain of the 3 aliases that attested it, and each epoch 5 percent of chains are re-run by a fresh alias that never saw the work. A chain caught faking loses its 20 POA stake, each attester loses 5 POA, and all 4 aliases are frozen for 8 epochs. A farm running 50 fake jobs in one epoch loses 1,000 POA in stakes plus 250 POA in fines. A raven audit picks which chains get re-run, and no alias learns its target until the job starts, so no farm can stage a fable of clean work in advance.
